name: Schotten Totten
summary: Two-player border-control card game where players build poker-like formations to claim boundary stones.
rules_text: Two players contest nine Stone tiles in a line. 54 Clan cards (6 colors x values 1-9) are shuffled; each player draws 6 cards. On a turn, play one card from hand face-up to your side of any unclaimed Stone, max 3 cards per player per Stone, cards cannot move after placed, then draw one card if deck remains. After playing, you may claim any Stone where both sides have 3 cards, or claim early if you can prove opponent cannot beat you using only cards already on table. Strongest formation wins Stone in order: Straight Flush (same color consecutive values), Three of a Kind, Flush, Straight, High sum. Tie broken by higher sum, then by who completed 3 first. Claimed Stones are removed from play. First to claim 5 Stones total or 3 adjacent Stones wins immediately.
rating_reason: Card battles for stones, hidden hands, poker combos, perfect for engine.
